identity.title: Pokémon Quiz Puzzle Land: Pikachu's Treasure Hunt

leadText:
----
(Japanese: Pokémon Quiz Puzzle Land: Pikachu's Treasure Hunt) is a Pokémon manga composed by Hiroshi Takase and illustrated by Kemon Kawamoto. It is serialized in the magazine, with the first chapter published in the issue 82, released on February 28, 2023. The manga utilizes quizzes and puzzles as a method of storytelling.
